preconditions.description: The input string s has length between 3 and 5000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdin.strip())
preconditions.description: The input string s consists only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output is a string representation of the probability that Vasya can uniquely determine k with optimal strategy, formatted as a decimal number with sufficient precision.

postconditions.expression: probability == sum(1.0 / len(s) for s in possible_winning_cases) / len(s)
postconditions.description: The probability is computed as the fraction of possible k values (0 to len(s)-1) where Vasya can uniquely determine k by optimally choosing a second character to reveal.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= k < len(s) for k in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: k is uniformly chosen from the range [0, len(s)-1].

postconditions.expression: possible_winning_cases == {k for k in range(len(s)) if can_uniquely_determine_k(s, k)}
postconditions.description: A k is a winning case if Vasya can uniquely determine it by optimally choosing a second character to reveal after seeing the first character of the shifted string.

postconditions.expression: can_uniquely_determine_k(s, k) == any(all(k != k2 for k2 in range(len(s)) if k2 != k and s[(k + i) % len(s)] == s[(k2 + i) % len(s)] for i in [0, second_pos]) for second_pos in range(1, len(s)))
postconditions.description: Vasya can uniquely determine k if there exists a second position such that the first and second characters of the shifted string uniquely identify k.
